WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS order_avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
timespan_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS timespan_avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    of.ordersmark,
    of.timespan,
    of.order_avg_fill,
    ta.timespan_avg_fill,
    of.order_avg_fill - ta.timespan_avg_fill AS exceeds_by
  FROM order_fills of
  JOIN timespan_avgs ta ON of.timespan = ta.timespan
  WHERE of.order_avg_fill > ta.timespan_avg_fill
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    order_avg_fill,
    exceeds_by,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY order_avg_fill DESC) AS rank_within_timespan
  FROM filtered_orders
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  order_avg_fill,
  exceeds_by,
  rank_within_timespan
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE rank_within_timespan <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rank_within_timespan;
